The '''Naj Syndicate''' was a criminal syndicate that was ran by the family of [[Quinlu Naj]]. It was headed by her father and operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. However, in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] began to squeeze them out of business.
